releaseTitle: ATalk v3.6.0 — Phone-Number-Free Contacts Hub, Biometric Auto-Lock, VoIP HUD & Deep Search
releaseNotes:
• 01 Phone-Number-Free Contacts Hub: Complete overhaul of Contacts & Peers with My Identity QR Badge sheet, Camera QR code viewfinder scanner, and direct peer pairing.
• 02 Anti-Spam Friend Handshake & Categories: Organized Contacts into 3 tabs (All, Favorites, Requests). Incoming connection requests require explicit Accept / Decline / Block authorization.
• 03 Biometric Inactivity Auto-Lock: Configurable background auto-lock timeout (Immediately, 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, Never) that seamlessly drops into the decoy Notes app upon background expiration.
• 04 Incognito Keyboard Enforcement: Added toggle to enforce flagNoPersonalizedLearning, preventing keyboard dictionaries (Gboard, SwiftKey) from learning or caching sensitive chat input.
• 05 Call Network Quality HUD: Real-time latency (ms), packet loss, and 2G resilience indicator badge in the VoIP active call header.
• 06 Video Call Screen Sharing: One-tap screen sharing control in the Active Call toolbar.
• 07 Deep Cross-Chat Full-Text & Media Search: Search message histories across all conversations with category filters (All, Messages, Media, Files, Links) and direct jump-to-chat navigation.
